title: Replication Data for: Co-creating Peri-Urban Lake Futures

contacts.name: Nikuze, Alice
contacts.affiliation: Faculty of Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation

descriptions: This dataset refers to “Co-creating Peri-Urban Lake Futures,” part of the study Peri-urban Lake Ecosystem Governance. It supports an inquiry into how plural lake imaginaries are elicited, negotiated, and mobilised to anticipate plausible socio-ecological futures for peri-urban lakes in Ahmedabad, India. The dataset includes workshop materials, lake-card elicitation tools, participant-generated outputs, qualitative coding files, synthesis tables, and related documentation, enabling transparency and further research on co-creation, environmental imaginaries, and anticipatory lake governance.
